arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent full-body cartoon sprite based on the FIRST image, an exact enlarged pixel-art pose. The SECOND image is ONLY the shared character identity/material/style reference, NOT its walking pose. Keep the source's exact facing, head angle, arm/hand positions and standing leg/foot silhouette. Same adult small worker: black cap, dark short hair, tan face/hands, bright green long-sleeve shirt, royal blue bib overalls, dark shoes; crisp black contour and clean cel shading, rounded natural anatomy. Do not trace pixel stairs. The standing feet/legs from the FIRST image must remain in their source stance, not the key's raised knee. Keep both hands and both feet. Match occlusion of head/arms rather than moving hands for visibility. True transparent RGBA background, no scenery, floor, shadows, halos, extra objects, text or duplicate figure. Leave about 5% transparent safety margin outside all contours.  Exactly TWO arms total, one left and one right, and exactly TWO hands total. Standing worker facing SCREEN-RIGHT in side profile, with one visible eye, eyebrow, nose and mouth. One hand is held across the forehead/cap brim like a lookout SALUTE, elbow bent outward toward screen-right. His other single arm hangs beside the torso at screen-left with hand near hip. Exactly two arms: one saluting, one hanging, NOT a third sleeve. Original slightly forward head tilt and two straight standing legs with offset shoes. Keep hand near brow rather than high overhead.
